title: Missing Index on documents.created_at Post-Migration
description:
Post-migration index verification failure. The documents.created_at index was dropped during PostgreSQL migration (NEX-189) and not recreated. The cleanup script caught a lock timeout error and swallowed it silently.

Impact: Search queries performing full table scans on 180M row documents table. 35% of users experienced timeouts for 1.5 hours on Nov 10.

Hotfix: PR #52 — created index concurrently, performance restored at 15:45 IST Nov 10.

Root cause and preventive measures documented in email_08 and incident_review_01 meeting.

Permanent fixes (from email_08):
- Diana Chen: Add index verification to migration runbook by Nov 19
- Kenji Nakamura: Automated index health checks by Nov 22
- Arjun Mehta: Review all migration scripts by Nov 20
